integrity: Analytical proof plus reproducible exact-arithmetic finite checks; no independent external verification has occurred.
limitations: Not for general nonorthogonal matrices, asynchronous scheduling, physical speedups, inconsistent data or arbitrary step schedules. Bibliographic equivalence to older minibatch optimization theory cannot be fully excluded.
scientific_scope: Exact conditional squared-error minimax for iid squared-residual row selection in an orthogonal two-row system using unaveraged common-snapshot corrections.
title: A sharp concurrency frontier for residual-weighted two-row Kaczmarz
